info.title: GACP Certification API
info.description:
## GACP Certification Platform API

API Documentation สำหรับระบบรับรองมาตรฐาน GACP (Good Agricultural and Collection Practices)

### Features:
- 🌱 **Plants** - จัดการข้อมูลพืชสมุนไพร
- 🌾 **Harvest Batches** - ติดตาม Lot และ Traceability
- 📋 **Config** - เทมเพลตแบบฟอร์มและมาตรฐาน
- ✅ **Validation** - ตรวจสอบก่อนยื่นใบสมัคร
- 🔐 **Auth** - ระบบ Authentication

### Thai ID Validation:
รองรับการตรวจสอบเลขบัตรประชาชนไทย 13 หลักตามมาตรฐานกระทรวงมหาดไทย

get.description:
Returns a paginated list across every applicant for admin CMS use.
Health IDs are masked per Sprint 6 C2 PII rule
(`1101900000005` → `1-****-*****-**-5`). The route file is gated
by `authenticateProvider` at the admin router mount; status
filtering is restricted to the canonical workflow allow-list.

schema.description: Optional workflow status filter (e.g. REGISTERED, SUBMITTED, APPROVED). Unknown values are ignored.

200.description: Paginated list of applications with masked health IDs

post.summary: Create or upsert a DRAFT application (HEALTH role only)
post.description:
Saves a wizard step payload onto the applicant's open draft, creating
a fresh DRAFT row when one does not already exist. Provider tokens
are rejected with HEALTH_ROLE_REQUIRED (V1-D D2 gate).

applicationId.description: Existing draft id to upsert into

200.description: Draft saved; returns draftId + applicationNumber + per-step validation summary

get.summary: Fetch the applicant's latest open DRAFT (HEALTH role)
get.description: Returns the most recent open draft for the authenticated HEALTH user, or null when none exists.

200.description: Draft payload (data is null when no open draft exists)

post.summary: Submit a DRAFT for review (HEALTH role only)
post.description:
Transitions the applicant's draft into the canonical review workflow.
Supports the four resubmit paths: DRAFT|REGISTERED → PENDING_DOC_FEE,
REVISION_REQUESTED → ASSIGNED_FOR_REVIEW, CAR_PENDING → CAR_REVIEWING.
Workspace capability SUBMIT_APPLICATION is enforced when an active
entity is on the request.

200.description: Submitted (or already in a submitted state); returns id + applicationNumber + status + nextRequiredAction

post.description: Saves an arbitrary partial wizard payload onto the authenticated applicant's draft. Idempotent — called repeatedly by the auto-save loop in the frontend.

schema.description: Wizard step payload — shape is dictated by the active wizard config

200.description: Draft saved

get.summary: Load the applicant's current wizard draft
get.description: Returns the latest wizard draft snapshot for the authenticated HEALTH user so the wizard can resume mid-step.

200.description: Current draft snapshot (or null when no draft exists)
List of audits

get.summary: Get pending applications for scheduling (Provider only)

200.description: List of pending applications
Audit details
Scheduled successfully
Result submitted

post.summary: Begin an on-site audit inspection (AUDITOR role)
post.description: Records the auditor's GPS at start time and returns the canonical checklist template. AUDITOR-scoped — only the assigned auditor (or ADMIN) may start.

200.description: Inspection started; returns checklist + gpsVerificationLog row

403.description: AUDIT_AUDITOR_MISMATCH — assigned auditor does not match caller

409.description: AUDIT_STATUS_INVALID — audit not in startable state

post.summary: File the final on-site audit decision (AUDITOR role)
post.description: Finalises the audit with PASS / FAIL / NEEDS_REVIEW and writes the workflow transition. Service-level guards enforce required-photo and complete-checklist preconditions.

200.description: Decision recorded; returns the persisted decision row + transition

409.description: AUDIT_STATUS_INVALID — audit not in decidable state

post.summary: Health applicant login with 13-digit Thai Health ID
post.description: Authenticates a HEALTH-role applicant and returns a JWT access token plus refresh cookies. Rate-limited at the server boundary.

200.description: Authenticated — returns access token + user payload

post.summary: Register a new HEALTH-role applicant with Thai national ID
post.description: Creates a new applicant account. Optional ID-card image upload (multipart/form-data) is hashed and retained per PDPA. Rate-limited.

201.description: Created — applicant registered; returns user + token payload

post.summary: Sign out the current applicant session
post.description: Clears the access/refresh/CSRF cookies and invalidates the refresh token server-side. Safe to call when no session is present (always returns 200).

200.description: Session cleared

get.description: Returns the current HEALTH user's profile, role, status, and tenant context derived from the JWT.

200.description: Current user profile

get.summary: List GACP certificates (scope depends on caller role)
get.description:
Provider roles (ADMIN/SCHEDULER/REVIEWER/AUDITOR/ACCOUNT*) get the
cross-tenant view (up to 100 rows). HEALTH applicants get a
self-scoped view. For public QR verification use the
/api/trace/* endpoints — those need no auth.

200.description: Returns the list of certificates with a count

get.summary: Fetch a single certificate by id (RBAC-aware)
get.description: Provider roles get any certificate via findById; HEALTH users only see their own (IDOR-safe through service-layer ownership filter).

200.description: Certificate detail with linked applicationNumber

404.description: Certificate not found (or HEALTH user is not the owner)

get.summary: Get all farms for authenticated user

200.description: List of farms
List of farms

get.summary: Get farms eligible for planting cycle creation

200.description: List of farms with active certificate and at least one plot

get.summary: List harvest batches for authenticated user

200.description: List of batches

get.summary: List payment invoices (applicant or finance staff view)
get.description:
HEALTH users see invoices for their own applications. ADMIN /
ACCOUNT_DTAM / ACCOUNT_PLATFORM / ACCOUNT see the system-wide
view. All other provider roles receive INVOICE_LISTING_FORBIDDEN.

200.description: Returns the list of invoices and a total count

403.description: INVOICE_LISTING_FORBIDDEN — provider role lacks finance permission

post.summary: Initiate a payment for an application (auto-detects phase)
post.description:
Canonical entry point — resolves Phase 1 vs Phase 2 from the
application status (or explicit `phase` override) and returns the
payment URL. Ownership is enforced server-side; non-owner HEALTH
users get 404. Every event hashes into the audit chain
(PAYMENT_INITIATED / PAYMENT_INITIATE_FAILED).

200.description: Payment created (or existing) — includes invoiceId, paymentUrl, expiresAt, fee breakdown

409.description: PAYMENT_PHASE_UNAVAILABLE — current status disallows new payment

post.description: Generates the Phase 1 invoice + PromptPay URL for the applicant's own application. Audit-logged as PAYMENT_PHASE1_INITIATED.

200.description: Invoice created — returns invoiceId, paymentUrl, requiredInvoices, phasePaid flag

400.description: Invalid application ID format or service-level rejection

post.description: Provider-only endpoint — SCHEDULER or ADMIN can trigger after document review is approved. Audit-logged as PAYMENT_PHASE2_INITIATED (or PAYMENT_PHASE2_INITIATE_DENIED on RBAC failure).

200.description: Invoice created — returns invoiceId, paymentUrl, requiredInvoices, phasePaid flag

403.description: Unauthorized to initiate phase 2 payment (role must be SCHEDULER or ADMIN)

post.summary: Upload a bank-transfer payment slip (HEALTH applicant)
post.description:
Multipart upload of a JPG/PNG/PDF (<= 5 MB). The slip is hashed
(SHA-256, persisted) and linked to either an application or a
subscription invoice. Audit-logged as PAYMENT_SLIP_UPLOADED.

applicationId.description: Provide exactly one of applicationId or subscriptionId

201.description: Slip recorded; returns the created PaymentSlip record

403.description: Forbidden — only HEALTH applicants may upload

post.summary: Approve a payment slip (finance reviewer or ADMIN)
post.description:
Marks the slip APPROVED and triggers the linked invoice payment.
Side-of-business is enforced: ACCOUNT_DTAM only reviews STATE-fee
slips, ACCOUNT_PLATFORM only reviews PLATFORM-fee/subscription
slips; ADMIN bypasses with an [admin-override] audit marker.

200.description: Slip approved; returns the updated PaymentSlip record

404.description: NOT_FOUND — slip not in caller's organization
